events.strDescriptionEN: Real Betis return to the UEFA Champions League after a 21-year absence with a difficult opening-night trip to Lille, where Manuel Pellegrini’s side will look to carry their strong domestic form onto Europe’s biggest stage. Lille arrive unbeaten in Ligue 1 and offer a dangerous blend of youth, physicality and attacking quality, while Betis will rely on their experienced creative core to make an immediate statement in the league phase.

events.strDescriptionEN: Real Madrid begin their 2026/27 UEFA Champions League campaign with a heavyweight home clash against Inter at the Santiago Bernabéu, where José Mourinho faces one of his former clubs on his return to European competition with Madrid. The hosts will look to rebound from their first LaLiga defeat of the season, while Inter arrive after a strong domestic start and will test Madrid with their physical structure, experience and attacking quality in one of Matchday 1’s standout fixtures.

UEFA Champions League 2026-10-14 Manchester City vs Paris Saint-Germain
events.strDescriptionEN: Manchester City welcome Paris Saint-Germain to the Etihad Stadium in one of the standout fixtures of the UEFA Champions League league phase. City enter the match after an excellent start to the season and opened their European campaign with a 2-0 victory away to Porto, while PSG began their defence of the trophy with an emphatic 6-1 win over Slovan Bratislava. The French side arrive as back-to-back European champions after winning the Champions League in both 2025 and 2026, giving City an opportunity to test themselves against the competition’s current benchmark. Recent meetings between the clubs have produced memorable contests, including PSG’s 4-2 comeback victory in Paris during the 2024-25 league phase. With two of Europe’s most talented squads meeting at the Etihad and both sides targeting another deep Champions League run, the match carries the profile and quality of a knockout-stage fixture despite arriving early in the league phase.
